value.rationale: Sharp sup-norm stability for the centered periodic Poisson equation is a natural operator invariant. Its leading quadratic growth, exact extremizing sign patterns, nonconvergent order-one correction and complete empirical distribution show a structurally meaningful arithmetic boundary phenomenon. This is not merely a recomputation of already known Green matrix entries.
